script:
set -eu
echo NODE_READ_STATE
printf 'pwd=%s\n' "$PWD"
printf 'tmp_state=%s\n' "$(cat /tmp/fabro-debug-state.txt 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
printf 'repo_state=%s\n' "$(cat .fabro/tmp/fabro-debug-state.txt 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
echo GIT_STATUS_BEGIN
git status --short || true
echo GIT_STATUS_END
echo ENV_SELECTED_BEGIN
env | sort | grep -E '^(FABRO|GITHUB|CI|HOME|PWD|USER|RUN|WORKFLOW|SANDBOX|PR|BASE|HEAD|BRANCH|GIT)=' || true
echo ENV_SELECTED_END
